summary: Make choices & shape your story in this text based RPG | CYOA
description: ⚔️ Embark on an immersive, text-based RPG adventure where your choices truly shape the story! Engage in deep interactions with NPCs, face thrilling medieval fantasy duels, and experience a tabletop-style Choose Your Own Adventure (CYOA) journey. Explore, strategize, and carve your own path in this interactive role-playing experience! Try before you buy! Eldrum: Untold is free to try up to a certain point in the story where you’ll be offered to purchase the full game in order to continue. Untold is an immersive text-based RPG adventure that blends classic Choose Your Own Adventure (CYOA) storytelling with modern gameplay twists. Shape your journey with meaningful choices, crafting a unique adventure that unfolds exactly the way you want. Your decisions drive the story—where will your path lead? Plot You wake up on a beach - shipwrecked, confused, and traumatized. Follow the footprints and you will find a fellow survivor in the wilderness. She is a nomad, who seems to have endured the same traumatic experiences. Together, you embark on a quest for answers and retribution. As you venture through the world to discover the truth in this interactive fiction story, you’ll gather equipment and forge your character. The lands of Tem Khiris are drenched in blood. You must figure out a way to survive in this world of warring states and rival tribes. Proceed with caution, for death lurks around every corner. Poor decisions will soon send you on a one-way trip to the Underworld. Choose your own adventure in this mobile text-based dark fantasy RPG! Main features of this text-based RPG (CYOA): ✔️ Tabletop Role-Playing Game - Experience the tabletop style RPG through the mysterious challenges that you will face. ✔️ Adventure Awaits - Uncover hidden secrets as every choice shapes your unique journey. Your path is yours to forge! ✔️ Character Upgrades - Equip, customize, and strengthen your hero to overcome greater threats. ✔️ Hours of Gameplay - Enjoy over 8 hours of thrilling playtime in this interactive medieval fantasy adventure. ✔️ High Replayability - Experiment with different playstyles, unlock new locations, meet unique NPCs, and discover powerful gear. Every playthrough is different! ✔️ Engaging Text-Based RPG - Dive into a richly crafted, story-driven RPG where your decisions lead to multiple endings. ✔️ Screen Reader Support - Fully accessible for blind and low-vision players with TalkBack compatibility. Choose wisely, because your choices matter! In the news “A full-on RPG, complete with character progression, inventory management, and NPC interactions ... The character development and combat systems find that sweet spot between being too simplistic to matter and becoming a bloated distraction.” – Gamespace.com “Untold RPG is a really solid and convenient package. It delivers feelings of grand adventure while allowing you to experiment and explore, and it does this pretty much all through the text. It may not satisfy folks looking for a flashier, more action-packed experience, but Untold's restraint is exactly what makes it so impressive and refreshing.” – 148apps.com Download this immersive CYOA text-based RPG and step into a world where every choice matters! Face thrilling challenges shaped by your decisions and experience the depth of a true tabletop role-playing adventure. Dive into an interactive fantasy story—just start playing and forge your own path! Join the community https://discord.eldrum.com
